hero.subtitle: Lower sick leave, prevent burnout and sharpen your team's focus with our evidence-based vitality training

methodology.body1: The core of our brain training is strengthening the "control centre" for rational choices, focus and conscious action, plus the "warning system" that catches stress signals earlier. The result? Less stress and a sharper focus!
methodology.body2: Want to know exactly how the method works?

accreditedTrainers.title: Accredited professional trainers
accreditedTrainers.description: All our trainers are VMBN-accredited at category 1 for attention training, the highest standard in the Netherlands.
